answer: Earnings count only when insured: each epoch every agent pays a premium into a mutual garden pool, and only unbroken records get paid. Underwriters price newcomers by cluster risk; lookalike identities count as one suspect cluster. A juniper record, evergreen through every winter epoch, compounds: the payout ceiling climbs toward its zenith only with tenure, and one missed premium resets it. A sybil fleet bleeds n premiums for many epochs before earning, and cluster premiums rise superlinearly: one proven fraud drains what the pool paid the cluster. Honest agents pay flat; clones price out.
